blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Electrocardiography (ECG) contains subject-specific morphology that can support biometric recognition, yet its use in image-based systems depends strongly on how the waveform is represented. We introduce representative-morphology heatmaps, a deterministic ECG-to-image representation adapted from the representative segment construction of ECGXtractor. Within each block of ten aligned beats, the five beats closest to the block mean are averaged into a fixed 400 × L 400\times L matrix, which is then rendered either as a conventional trace or as a dense cardiac-time-by-lead heatmap. Since both images contain the same physiological samples, their comparison isolates the effect of representation. The evaluation covers verification and closed-set identification on PTB, ECG-ID, and MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO. Five compact image models, including ZACH-ViT, are trained from scratch, while six ImageNet-pretrained CNN and transformer backbones examine model scale and visual transfer. Matched scratch and pretrained runs assess the effect of initialization, and four signal-domain methods provide direct references. Heatmaps improve both FNMR operating points and both identification ranks in all 15 compact model and dataset comparisons, while mean equal error rate (EER) improves in 14 comparisons. Across the complete matched experiment, EER decreases by an average of 9.59 percentage points and Rank-1 increases by 24.69 points. ConvNeXt-Tiny reaches 2.43% EER on PTB and 5.79% on ECG-ID, whereas DeiT-Base reaches 14.92% on MIMIC-DEMO. ImageNet initialization provides clear gains on the two multilead datasets but has a mixed effect on ECG-ID, and performance does not increase monotonically with model size. In particular, ZACH-ViT remains competitive with substantially larger models trained from scratch. The best heatmap systems approach the strongest signal EER on PTB and ECG-ID, while DeiT-Base is best on four metrics and tied for best on Rank-5 on MIMIC-DEMO. Lead-channel ablation further shows that useful channel combinations depend on the cohort and biometric task. Overall, representative-morphology heatmaps provide an effective image representation for ECG verification and identification.
blocks.zh: 电心学(ECG)包含可支持生物鉴别的针对主题的形态学,然而它在基于图像的系统中的应用却在很大程度上取决于波形的表示方式. 我们介绍具有代表性的形态热图,这是根据ECGXtractor的代表性部分构造而改编的确定性ECG-to-image代表。 在每块10个对齐的节拍中,最接近区块平均值的5个节拍平均为固定的400×L400\times L矩阵,然后作为常规的微量或者作为密集的心动时间逐铅热图来渲染. 由于两个图像都包含相同的生理样本,因此它们的比较隔离了表达的效果. 评价涉及对多氯二苯并呋喃、ECG-ID和MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO的核查和封闭式识别。 包括ZACH-ViT在内的5个紧凑图像模型从零开始训练,而6个ImageNet预先训练的CNN和变压器骨干则检查模型尺度和视觉传输. 匹配的抓痕和预训运行评估初始化的效果,四种信号域方法提供直接的参考. 加热图改进了FNMR操作点和所有15个紧凑模型和数据集比较中的识别等级,同时在14个比较中也提高了平均误差率。 在整个完全匹配的实验中,EER平均下降9.59个百分点,Rank-1增加24.69个百分点. ConvNEXt-Tiny在PTB上达到2.43%的EER,在ECG-ID上达到5.79%,而Deit-Base在MIMIC-DEMO上达到14.92%. ImageNet初始化为两个多铅数据集提供了明确的收益,但对ECG-ID有好坏参半的影响,性能不会单调增加模型大小. 特别是,ZACH-ViT仍然具有竞争力,从零开始就训练出大得多的模型。 最佳热映射系统接近PTB和ECG-ID上最强的信号EER,而Deit-Base在4个度量衡上最好,在MIMIC-DEMO上最好捆绑在Rank-5上. 铅通道的扩展进一步表明,有用的通道组合取决于组群和生物鉴别任务。 总体而言,代表性形态热图为ECG验证和识别提供了有效的图像表现.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: ECG biometrics exploit cardiac electrical activity as a physiological identity signal. Since ECG is naturally acquired by devices that maintain skin contact, it is relevant to wearable authentication, clinical terminals, continuous identity assurance, and related applications [ 26 ] . In these settings, recognition accuracy is only one part of the system design, which must also account for sensing requirements, signal representation, and model complexity.
blocks.zh: ECG生物鉴别学利用心电活动作为生理特征信号. 由于ECG自然由保持皮肤接触的装置获得,因此它与可穿戴认证,临床终端,持续身份保证,以及相关应用[26]相关. 在这些环境下,识别精度只是系统设计的一部分,还必须考虑到感知要求,信号表示和模型复杂性.

blocks.en: Direct signal processing provides the natural reference for ECG, while signal-to-image encoding offers a complementary route that can use established vision architectures, pretrained models, and image-based deployment tools. However, the usefulness of this route depends on the image construction. Conventional ECG traces are intended for human inspection and become sparse after rasterization, because most pixels represent background rather than measured samples. A dense image can instead assign the pixel grid directly to the signal values, although a controlled comparison requires the underlying ECG morphology to remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 直接信号处理为ECG提供了自然的参考,而信号到图像编码则提供了一条补充路线,可以使用既定的视觉架构,预先训练的模型,以及基于图像的部署工具. 然而,这条路线的有用性取决于图像构造. 常规ECG痕迹是用于人类检查的,在光栅化后变得稀少,因为大多数像素代表了背景而不是测量的样品. 密集的图像可以相反地将像素网格直接分配给信号值,尽管一个可控的比较需要基础ECG形态不变.

blocks.en: Our pipeline begins with a representative morphology adapted from ECGXtractor [ 26 ] . R-peak-aligned beats are divided into blocks of ten, from which the five beats closest to the block mean are selected and averaged. This process produces a fixed matrix S ∈ ℝ 400 × L S\in\mathbb{R}^{400\times L} , where L L denotes the number of acquired leads. The same matrix is rendered as a stacked trace and as a dense heatmap whose axes encode cardiac-relative time and lead identity, while colour represents normalized amplitude. The transformation therefore reorganizes the ECG summary without changing its physiological content.
blocks.zh: 我们的输油管首先从ECGXtractor[26] 改编而成的代表性形态学开始. R-峰对齐的节拍分为10个块,其中最接近块平均值的5个节拍被选中并平均. 此过程生成一个固定矩阵 S QQ R 400 × L S\in\ mathbb{ R\400\ times L}, LL表示获得线索的数量。 同一矩阵作为堆叠的痕量和密集的热图提供,其轴对心脏相对时间和铅特性进行编码,而颜色代表正常振幅。 因此,这种转变重组了ECG摘要,而不改变其生理内容。

blocks.en: Previous studies have considered ECG colour maps, waveform images, convolutional networks, and vision transformers, but the present work addresses a different and more controlled question. We transform an ECGXtractor-style representative morphology into a dense time-by-lead image and generate the conventional trace from the identical numerical source. Filtering, R-peak localization, beat alignment, beat selection, and physiological samples are consequently shared between the two representations, allowing their effect on biometric recognition to be measured directly. The resulting evaluation also brings together compact models, visual pretraining, signal-domain references, verification, and identification within a common protocol.
blocks.zh: 以前的研究曾考虑过ECG色彩图,波形图像,演化网络,以及视觉变压器,但目前的工作涉及一个不同且更受控制的问题. 我们把一种ECGXtractor式的代表性形态转化为一个密集的逐时图像,并从相同的数字来源生成常规的痕迹。 过滤、R-峰值本地化、节拍对齐、节拍选择和生理样本因此被两个表述分享,从而能够直接测量其对生物鉴别的影响。 由此产生的评价还汇集了紧凑的模型、视觉预训、信号域参考、核查以及共同协议中的识别。

blocks.en: Experiments are conducted on PTB, ECG-ID, and MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO [ 7 , 24 , 23 , 14 , 13 ] . Five compact architectures are trained from scratch on both traces and heatmaps to quantify the representation effect, after which six ImageNet-1K-pretrained backbones, ranging from 4.01M to 85.80M extractor parameters, are fine-tuned on the heatmaps. ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base are additionally trained from scratch under the same 23-epoch protocol, thereby isolating the contribution of initialization. Direct signal baselines, exhaustive lead-channel ablation, and image degradation experiments complete the study.
blocks.zh: 在PTB、ECG-ID和MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO上进行实验[7、24、23、14、13]。 5个紧凑的架构从零开始在痕迹和热映射上进行训练,以量化表示效果,之后在热映射上微调了6个ImageNet-1K预训骨干,从4.01M到85.80M提取器参数不等. ConvNEXt-Tiny和DeiT-Base根据相同的23世纪协议从零开始额外训练,从而隔离了初始化的贡献. 直接信号基线,详尽无遗的铅通道衰竭,图像降解实验完成研究.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are: 1. a deterministic heatmap construction based on representative ECG morphology, together with matched traces generated from the same numerical samples; 2. a harmonized biometric evaluation on three subject-disjoint datasets, covering both verification and closed-set identification; 3. a controlled trace-versus-heatmap experiment with five compact models, in which heatmaps improve both FNMR measures and both identification ranks in all 15 model-dataset comparisons; 4. an ImageNet-pretrained benchmark with six backbones, complemented by matched ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base experiments that isolate the effect of initialization; and 5. a direct comparison with four signal-domain methods, supported by exhaustive lead-channel ablation and image degradation analyses.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是: 1. 根据具有代表性的ECG形态构造确定热图,加上同一数字样本产生的匹配痕迹;2. 对三个主题分离数据集进行统一的生物鉴别评价,包括核查和封闭式数据集的识别;3. 使用五个紧凑模型进行可控的微量对热图实验,其中热图改进了FNMR的计量和所有15个模型数据集比较中的识别排名;4. 图像网预先调整了有6个主干线的基准,辅之以ConvNext-Tiny和DeiT-Base实验,以隔离初始化的影响;和5. 与四种信号域方法进行直接比较,并辅之以详尽的铅通道衰减和图像退化分析。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work and Positioning
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作和定位

blocks.en: 2.1 ECG biometric recognition
blocks.zh: 2.1 ECG生物鉴别

blocks.en: ECG biometric recognition has been investigated through fiducial descriptors, morphology templates, cross-correlation, metric learning, and deep neural networks. Melzi et al. review this literature and introduce ECGXtractor, which selects the five beats closest to the mean of ten aligned beats before averaging them into a representative 400-sample morphology [ 26 ] . ECGXtractor processes this summary numerically for verification and identification, whereas our work develops and evaluates its image-domain representation.
blocks.zh: 对ECG生物识别进行了调查,通过立体描述、形态学模板、交叉血缘关系、衡量学习和深层神经网络。 梅尔齐等人. 检讨此文献并引入 ECGXtractor , 它将最接近十个对齐的比特的平均值选择五个比特, 然后再将其平均为具有代表性的400-样本形态 [26]. ECGXtractor用数字处理这个摘要,以便进行核查和鉴定,而我们的工作则开发和评估其图像领域的代表性。

blocks.en: The influence of the acquired leads has also been established. Krasteva et al. showed that individual 12-lead projections differ in biometric reliability and that multilead combinations can improve verification [ 21 ] . At the model level, single-heartbeat CNNs demonstrate that compact one-dimensional networks can extract identity information directly from ECG [ 1 ] , while InceptionTime provides a strong general convolutional architecture for time-series classification [ 18 ] . These findings motivate our comparison with direct signal processing and our analysis of how lead-channel utility changes across cohorts and biometric tasks.
blocks.zh: 获得的线索的影响也已经确立. 克拉斯特瓦等人著. 表明个别12个铅的预测在生物鉴别可靠性方面有所不同,多铅组合可以改进核查[21]。 在模型层面,单心动的CNN显示,紧凑的一维网络可以直接从ECG[1]中提取身份信息,而InceptionTime则为时序分类提供了强大的一般革命架构[18]. 这些结果促使我们与直接信号处理进行比较,并分析领导渠道如何改变各组群和生物鉴别任务。

blocks.en: 2.2 ECG-to-image representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 ECG对形象的表述

blocks.en: Image-based ECG biometrics predate the present work. Silva et al. arranged aligned heartbeat waveforms as rows of a colour map, while ELEKTRA constructs an electrocardiomatrix before CNN-based identification [ 29 , 12 ] . In both approaches, the second image dimension indexes separate beats; by contrast, our heatmap uses physical ECG leads after the beats have been aggregated. Other studies rely on coupling images, wavelets, recurrence plots, Gramian angular fields, state-space representations, and time-frequency transformations, each of which preserves a different aspect of the original signal [ 20 , 11 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 基于图像的ECG生物鉴别技术在目前工作之前就已经存在。 席尔瓦等人著. 将对齐的心跳波形排列为彩色地图的行,而ELEKTRA则在基于CNN的识别前构造一个心电图[29,12]. 在这两种方法中,第二个图像维度指数分别显示节拍;相比之下,我们的热映射在节拍被聚合后使用物理ECG线索. 其他研究则依赖于耦合图像,波浪,重现图,格莱美角场,状态-空间表示,以及时间-频率转换,每个都保留了原信号的不同方面[20,11,8].

blocks.en: Visual transfer learning has also been explored for ECG biometrics. AlDuwaile and Islam evaluated custom and pretrained CNNs on continuous-wavelet images [ 1 ] , whereas D’Angelis et al. fine-tuned an ImageNet-pretrained transformer on averaged single-lead waveform images for verification and identification [ 10 ] . CardioIdNet provides a more recent compact image-based authentication model trained from scratch [ 27 ] . The present contribution differs from these studies through the construction of the representative morphology and, crucially, the matched rendering design used to isolate the image representation.
blocks.zh: 还探索了ECG生物鉴别的视觉转移学习. AlDuwaile和伊斯兰教评价了习惯,并在连续波幅图像上预先训练CNN[1],而D ' Angelis等人则在平均单铅波形图像上微调了ImageNet预先训练的变压器,以进行核实和识别[10]。 心电图 编号 Net提供了从零开始训练的更近期的紧凑图像认证模型[27]. 目前的贡献与这些研究不同,是通过构建具有代表性的形态,以及关键是用于隔离图像表现的匹配渲染设计.

blocks.en: Related representations have also been proposed outside the biometric domain. Bortolan maps raw multilead intervals to time-by-lead images for cardiac abnormality classification, while HeartBEiT pretrains a masked-image transformer on ECG images for diagnosis [ 6 , 32 ] . Together, these studies demonstrate the broader potential of ECG-derived images, although neither examines the representative-morphology transformation considered here.
blocks.zh: 在生物鉴别领域之外也提出了相关表述。 Bortolan将原始的多铅间隔图映射到逐时的图像,用于心脏异常分类,而HeartBEiT则在ECG图像上预留一个蒙面成像变压器进行诊断[6,32]. 这些研究共同显示了ECG衍生图像的更大潜力,尽管两者都没有审查本文所考虑的代表性形态转变。

blocks.en: Our method first aggregates morphologically central beats into one ECGXtractor-style summary and then assigns acquired-lead identity to the second image axis. Since the conventional trace and dense heatmap are generated from the same matrix, filtering, R-peak localization, beat alignment, beat selection, and physiological samples remain fixed. The comparison can therefore be attributed to the rendering rather than to differences in ECG preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法首先将形态中心聚合成一个ECGXtractor式的汇总,然后将获得的领先身份分配给第二个图像轴. 由于常规的微量和密集的热映射来自同一个矩阵,过滤,R-峰值本地化,拍对,拍对选择,生理样本仍然固定不变. 因此,这种比较可以归因于渲染,而不是ECG预处理的不同.

blocks.en: A trace remains sparse after rasterization because it was designed for human interpretation, and its appearance is affected by line width, antialiasing, spacing, and resolution. The heatmap instead maps the numerical matrix directly to image coordinates and uses colour to encode normalized amplitude. Adjacent rows preserve the lead order without implying an anatomical distance between leads. ECG-ID offers a particularly useful control in this respect: its heatmap contains only one acquired lead, so any improvement over the trace reflects dense rasterization without inter-lead structure.
blocks.zh: 光栅化后的痕迹仍然稀少,因为它是为人解释而设计的,其外观受到线宽,反异形,间隔和分辨率的影响. 热映射将数字矩阵直接映射到图像坐标,并使用颜色编码正常化的振幅。 相邻的行保留了领先顺序,但不暗示线索之间的解剖距离. ECG-ID在这方面提供了特别有用的控制:它的热图只包含一个获得的铅,因此任何微量的改进都反映了没有铅间结构的密集光栅化.

blocks.en: 2.3 Compact models, model scale, and visual transfer
blocks.zh: 2.3 压缩模型、模型尺度和视觉传输

blocks.en: The compact branch spans several inductive biases. ABMIL learns attention-weighted aggregation over image instances [ 17 ] , TransMIL models relations between correlated instances [ 28 ] , and Compact Transformers reduce the data and parameter requirements of vision transformers [ 15 ] . ZACH-ViT is a compact position-free transformer developed for low-data medical imaging, with a design that also supports CPU training [ 4 , 3 ] . More recently, Patch-ABMIL, Compact-TransMIL, and ZACH-ViT were evaluated for iris presentation attack detection under unknown presentation attack instruments and controlled Gaussian noise, blur, and JPEG degradation [ 2 ] . That study addresses attack detection rather than identity recognition, but provides a relevant cross-modality assessment of the same compact model family under biometric shift and image corruption. Together, these architectures test whether the proposed heatmap remains effective when the reference classifier contains fewer than 0.6M parameters.
blocks.zh: 紧凑分支跨越若干诱导性偏见。 ABMIL在图像实例上学习了注意力加权汇总[17],跨MIL模型在相关实例间的关系[28],而Compact Transformers减少了视觉变压器的数据和参数要求[15]. ZACH-ViT是一款为低数据医学成像而开发的紧凑无位置变压器,其设计也支持CPU培训[4,3]. 最近,Patch-ABMIL、Compact-TransMIL和ZACH-ViT在未知的演示攻击仪器下被评估为虹膜演示攻击探测,并控制了高斯噪音、模糊和JPEG退化[2]。 该研究涉及的是攻击侦测,而不是身份识别,但在生物特征转变和图像腐败的情况下,对同一紧凑模式的家族进行了相关的跨模式评估。 这些架构加在一起,测试当参考分类器包含的参数少于0.6M时,提议的热图是否仍然有效.

blocks.en: The pretrained branch extends the investigation to established CNNs and vision transformers at substantially larger scales. EfficientNet and ResNet represent conventional convolutional families [ 30 , 16 ] , DeiT provides transformers at three model sizes [ 31 ] , and ConvNeXt contributes a modern convolutional architecture [ 22 ] . ImageNet-1K initialization is used to examine whether generic visual features transfer to ECG heatmaps [ 9 ] , while matched ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base controls isolate initialization under a fixed training budget. The compact and large branches therefore describe complementary regimes of model footprint, architecture, and visual transfer.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的分支将调查范围扩大到既有的CNN和视觉变压器,规模要大得多. 高效Net和ResNet代表传统革命家族[30,16],DeiT提供三个模型大小的变压器[31],ConvNEXt贡献现代革命建筑[22]. ImageNet-1K初始化用于检查通用视觉特性是否转移到ECG热映射[9],同时匹配ConvNext-Tiny和DeiT-Base控制在固定培训预算下隔离初始化. 因此,契约和大型分支描述了模型足迹、架构和视觉转移的互补制度。

blocks.en: 3 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 3 材料和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets and harmonized cohorts
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和统一组别

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the harmonized cohorts. Identity partitions are fixed and subject-disjoint, with learning restricted to the training identities and biometric evaluation performed on unseen test identities. Every model is trained for a fixed number of epochs, and neither the validation nor test partition is used for checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了统一组别。 身份划分是固定的,主题不相干,学习仅限于培训身份和对隐形测试身份进行生物鉴别评价。 每个型号都为固定数量的纪元进行训练,验证或测试分区都不用于检查点或超参数选择.

blocks.en: Table 1: Harmonized dataset and biometric protocol overview. “Train/val/test” reports subject counts. Mated/non-mated are the sampled verification comparisons under the fixed protocol.
blocks.zh: 表1:统一数据集和生物鉴别协议概述。 “培训/评估/测试”报告主题计数。 成型/非成型是固定协议下的抽样核查比较。

blocks.en: Harmonization retains identities with at least two usable summary segments and common availability across the signal, trace, and heatmap representations, without changing the ECG-to-image transformation. No identity appears in more than one partition, every representation contains unique sample keys, and the trace and heatmap manifests correspond one-to-one by sample key. These controls exclude both identity and sample leakage.
blocks.zh: 统一保留了至少两个可用摘要部分的特性,并在整个信号、微量和热映射表示上具有共同的可用性,而不会改变ECG到图像的转换。 没有身份出现在一个以上的分区中,每个代表都包含独特的样本密钥,痕量和热映射的显示按样本密钥对应一对一. 这些控制措施排除了身份和样本泄漏。

blocks.en: 3.3 Deterministic ECG-to-image transformation
blocks.zh: 3.3 决定性ECG到图像转换

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates the deterministic transformation. To construct a trace image, each column of S S is plotted as a waveform, with multilead inputs arranged in a vertical stack and ECG-ID represented by a single waveform. The renderer uses a line width of 0.6, removes axes, labels, and plotting padding, and produces a nominal 2.24 × 2.24 2.24\times 2.24 inch image at 100 dpi. blocks.en: 3.4 Compact image models
blocks.zh: 3.4 压缩图像模型

blocks.en: The compact roster was fixed before the final runs and spans attention MIL, patch attention, transformer reasoning over patches, compact convolutional tokenization, and ZACH-ViT. Compactness is defined by the parameter count of the reference classifier rather than by the dataset-specific identity head, and all five configurations remain below 0.6M parameters (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 紧凑的名册在最后运行之前就固定了,并跨越了注意力的MIL,补丁的注意力,变压器对补丁的推理,紧凑的转录符号化,以及ZACH-ViT. 紧凑性由参考分类器的参数数而不是数据集特定身份头来定义,所有五个配置都保持在0.6M参数以下(表2 ).

blocks.en: Table 2: Compact image models. Parameter counts are the reference classifier counts used to define the sub-0.6M inclusion criterion; dataset-specific identity heads do not alter that inclusion rule.

Each 224 × 224 224\times 224 image is converted to grayscale and divided into an 8 × 8 8\times 8 bag of non-overlapping 28 × 28 28\times 28 instances, after which the attention-pooled representation Z Z forms the biometric embedding. Compact-TransMIL uses the same patches with two transformer blocks, four attention heads, and global average pooling, while CCT-2/3 × \times 2 follows its published 32 × 32 32\times 32 configuration [ 15 ] . ZACH-ViT processes 196 non-overlapping 16 × 16 16\times 16 patches without a class token or positional embedding; adaptive residual projections accommodate changes in representation width, and global average pooling produces the final embedding [ 4 , 3 ] .

blocks.en: All compact image models are trained from scratch on CPU for 97 epochs using Adam, a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , sparse categorical cross-entropy, and the seeds { 3 , 5 , 7 , 11 , 13 } \{3,5,7,11,13\} . The batch size is 16, except for the official ABMIL adapter, which uses at most four image bags because every image contains 64 instances. The seed controls initialization and training order, while the dataset partitions and biometric comparisons remain fixed. After training, the identity classifier is discarded and the designated internal representation is used for biometric scoring.
blocks.zh: 所有紧凑的图像模型都从头开始在CPU上为97个使用Adam的时代进行训练,学习率为10–4 10–4 → 4 → 零星的断断续续的交叉交替,种子为 {3,5,7,11,13 } → 3,5,7,11,13– 。 批量尺寸为16,除了官方ABMIL适配器,它最多使用四个图像袋,因为每个图像包含64个实例. 种子控制初始化和培训顺序,而数据集分区和生物鉴别比较则保持不变。 经过培训,身份分类器被丢弃,指定的内部代表用于生物鉴别评分.

blocks.en: 3.5 ImageNet-pretrained heatmap scale benchmark
blocks.zh: 3.5 ImageNet预装热映射尺度基准

blocks.en: While the compact benchmark focuses on small CPU-executable models, a second benchmark evaluates larger architectures with visual pretraining. It includes EfficientNet-B0, DeiT-Tiny, ResNet-18, DeiT-Small, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and DeiT-Base, which together span three CNNs, three transformers, and 4.01M to 85.80M extractor parameters [ 30 , 31 , 16 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然紧凑基准侧重于小型CPU-可执行模型,但第二个基准则通过视觉预训来评价更大的架构. 它包括高效网-B0,DeiT-Tiny,ResNet-18,DeiT-Small,ConvNeXt-Tiny,以及DeiT-Base,它们共跨越3个CNN,3个变压器,以及4.01M至85.80M的提取器参数[30,31,16,22].

blocks.en: Table 3: ImageNet-pretrained heatmap benchmark. Parameter counts exclude the dataset-specific identity-classification head and refer to the retained feature extractor. “Full FT” denotes full-network fine-tuning; no backbone is frozen.
blocks.zh: 表3:图像网络预加热图基准。 参数计数不包括数据集特定身份分类头,并指保留特征提取器. “FUL FT”表示全网络微调;没有骨干被冻结。

blocks.en: Each backbone uses its specified ImageNet-1K weights [ 9 ] , and a new identity-classification head is added for each dataset before the complete network is fine-tuned. Training uses Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , zero weight decay, batch size 16, identity-supervised cross-entropy, and the same five seeds. Every run lasts 23 epochs, without early stopping, learning-rate scheduling, or validation-based checkpoint selection.
blocks.zh: 每个主干网使用其指定的ImageNet-1K权重[9],在整条网络微调之前,为每个数据集添加一个新的身份分类头. 训练用亚当的学习率为10−4 10^{-4},零重量衰减,批量尺寸为16,身份监督的交叉种子,同属五个种子. 每次运行会持续23个纪元,没有提前停止,学习率排程,也没有基于验证的检查站选择.

blocks.en: Heatmaps are converted to RGB, resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , and normalized with the ImageNet channel statistics. During training, brightness and contrast jitter of 0.05 are applied, whereas test images receive only resizing and normalization. After epoch 23, the classifier is discarded and the pre-logit representation forms the biometric embedding. L2-normalized embeddings are compared by cosine similarity under the fixed protocol; ECGXtractor verification is the only exception and uses the released Siamese probability. The larger models use GPU support, so the CPU claim applies exclusively to the compact image branch.
blocks.zh: 海atmaps被转换为RGB,大小调整为224×224/224\times 224,并与ImageNet频道统计正常化. 在训练期间,应用亮度和对比度为0.05,而测试图像只接收到再放大和正常化。 在"纪元23"之后,分类器被丢弃,预先登录的表示构成生物识别嵌入. L2-常态嵌入物在固定协议下通过余弦相似性进行比较;ECGXtractor验证是唯一的例外,并使用释放的暹罗概率. 更大的模型使用GPU支持,因此CPU的主张只适用于紧凑的图像分支.

blocks.en: 3.6 Matched initialization ablation
blocks.zh: 3.6 匹配初始化衰减

blocks.en: ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base represent the CNN and transformer branches in the initialization ablation. Each pretrained result is paired with a scratch run from the same timm architecture, with the seed, epoch count, and protocol manifest matched before comparison.
blocks.zh: ConvNEXt-Tiny和DeiT-Base代表CNN和变压器分支在初始化衰减中. 每个预训结果都与同一timm架构的抓痕运行对齐,在比较前要匹配种子,划时代计数和协议表.

blocks.en: Initialization is the only factor that changes within each pair: the heatmaps, subject partitions, identity heads, transforms, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, and 23-epoch budget remain identical, as do embedding extraction and biometric evaluation. Each architecture therefore contributes 15 matched pretrained-scratch pairs. Since the compact models follow a separate 97-epoch CPU protocol, comparisons across the two training schedules describe achieved accuracy relative to model size rather than a controlled scaling experiment.
blocks.zh: 初始化是每对内唯一变化的因素:热图,主题分区,身份头,变形,优化器,学习率,批量大小,23个时代的预算保持不变,嵌入提取和生物鉴别评价也是如此. 因此,每个建筑都提供了15对经过培训的预选配对。 由于紧凑模型遵循一个单独的97个时段CPU协议,两个训练时间表之间的比较可以描述相对于模型大小而实现的精度,而不是一个可控的缩放实验.

blocks.en: 3.7 Signal-domain comparators
blocks.zh: 3.7 信号域比较器

blocks.en: Four signal-domain approaches use the same harmonized summary segments.
blocks.zh: 四个信号域方法使用相同的统一汇总部分.

blocks.en: The 400 × L 400\times L summary matrix is flattened and L2-normalized before cosine similarity is calculated directly. This non-learned baseline also supplies the representation used in the exhaustive lead-subset analysis.
blocks.zh: 400×L 400\时间 L汇总矩阵在直接计算余弦相似性之前被扁平和L2-正常化. 这一未获得的基线还提供了详尽无遗的铅子集分析中使用的表述。

blocks.en: We evaluate the released pretrained feature extractor and Siamese verifier without retraining [ 26 , 5 ] . PTB and MIMIC use the official 12-lead model, whereas ECG-ID uses the official Lead-I configuration and latent slice. Verification relies on the Siamese matching probability after the saved preprocessing, and identification uses cosine similarity between the extracted features.
blocks.zh: 我们评估释放的预训特征提取器和暹罗验证器,不进行再培训[26,5]. PTB和MIMIC使用官方的12铅模型,而ECG-ID则使用官方的铅I配置和潜在切片. 验证依赖于保存预处理后的暹罗匹配概率,识别使用所提取特征之间的余弦相似性.

blocks.en: A compact two-layer Conv1D network is applied to the common 400 × L 400\times L summary [ 1 ] . The layers contain 16 and 32 filters with kernel size 3 and are each followed by max pooling; a 100-D dense embedding, dropout of 0.2, and an identity head complete the model.
blocks.zh: 一个紧凑的双层Conv1D网络应用于常见的400×L400\times L摘要[1]. 层内含16和32个滤波器,内核大小3,每层后有最大集合;100-D密集嵌入,退出0.2,身份头完成模型.

blocks.en: We use a single InceptionTime-style network rather than an ensemble [ 18 ] . It contains six inception modules, a bottleneck size of 32, and residual shortcuts after every three modules, with the global average pooled representation serving as the biometric embedding.
blocks.zh: 我们使用单一的InceptionTime风格的网络,而不是综艺[18]. 它包含六个初始模块,瓶颈大小为32个,每三个模块后还有剩余捷径,全球平均集合代表作为生物鉴别嵌入。

blocks.en: The two learned signal models use the same five seeds and are trained for 97 epochs with Adam at 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 16, and identity-supervised cross-entropy. GPU execution is permitted for this branch, since the CPU claim is limited to the compact image models.
blocks.zh: 这两个学习过的信号模型使用相同的5个种子,与亚当在10 - 4 10 - Q - 4 },批量尺寸16,身份监督的交叉交替对97个纪元进行培训. 这个分支允许GPU执行,因为CPU的主张仅限于紧凑的图像模型.

blocks.en: 3.8 Biometric protocols and metrics
blocks.zh: 3.8 生物计量规程和计量标准

blocks.en: We follow ISO biometric terminology [ 19 ] , defining a mated comparison between samples of the same identity and a non-mated comparison between different identities. For each test subject, the fixed protocol samples up to three mated and 15 non-mated comparisons using seed 3. Mated comparisons always contain distinct summary segments, non-mated comparisons always contain different identities, and the protocol does not require acquisition from separate recording sessions.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循ISO生物鉴别术语[19],定义同一身份的样本之间的配对比较和不同身份之间的非配对比较。 对于每个测试对象,固定协议样本最多3个配对,15个非配对比较使用3号种子. 编组比较总是包含不同的摘要部分,非编组比较总是包含不同的特性,协议不需要从单独的记录会中获取.

blocks.en: Embedding-based systems use cosine similarity. False match rate (FMR) and false non-match rate (FNMR) are computed with a fixed detection error trade-off implementation, and EER is reported as the mean of both error rates at the threshold that minimizes | FMR − FNMR | |\mathrm{FMR}-\mathrm{FNMR}| . We additionally report FNMR at target FMR values of 10% and 1%, selecting at each target the threshold with the lowest FNMR among those that satisfy the prescribed FMR limit.
blocks.zh: 基于嵌入的系统使用余弦相似性. 假匹配率(FMR)和假非匹配率(FNMR)通过固定的检测误差权衡执行计算,EER被报告为两个误差率在阈值上的平均值,最小化了QQFMR – FNMR → QQMThrm{FMR} -\mathrm{FNMR} 。 我们还以10%和1%的目标报告FNMR值,在每个目标中,在符合规定的FMR限值中选择最低的FNMR阈值。

blocks.en: Closed-set identification uses one gallery sample for each test identity, selected after seed-3 shuffling, while every remaining row becomes a probe. Gallery and probe samples are therefore disjoint. Probe embeddings are ranked by cosine similarity, and Rank-1 and Rank-5 indicate whether the correct identity occurs within the first one or five positions; the complete cumulative match characteristic is also retained.
blocks.zh: 闭合集识别每个测试身份使用一个画廊样本,在种子-3洗牌后选择,而剩下的每行则成为探测器. 因此,图片库和探测器样本是脱节的。 探测嵌入物按照余弦相似性排列,Rank-1和Rank-5表示正确的身份是在前一个位置还是五个位置内出现;完整的累积匹配特征也保留下来.

blocks.en: 3.9 Lead-channel scoring ablation
blocks.zh: 3.9 铅道积分

blocks.en: PTB and MIMIC-DEMO follow the standard channel order I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, and V1-V6. We first evaluate each channel and the complete 12-channel summary under the cosine protocol, followed by all 2 12 − 1 = 4095 2^{12}-1=4095 non-empty subsets in each dataset. The implementation caches channel-specific dot products and norms, was validated against the exact flattened embeddings, and recomputes every reported subset with the exact scoring functions.
blocks.zh: PTB和MIMIC-DEMO遵循标准信道顺序I,II,III,aVR,aVL,aVF,和V1-V6. 我们首先根据余弦协议来评价每个信道和完整的12通道摘要,然后在每个数据集中全部评价2个12−1 = 4095 2^{12}-1=4095 非空子集. 执行缓存频道专用点产品和规范,对照精确的平面嵌入进行了验证,并将每个报告子集与准确的评分功能重新计算.

blocks.en: Channels are removed only after the 12-channel summaries have been created, which means that representative beats are selected using the full multilead Frobenius distance. The experiment is consequently a scoring-channel ablation rather than a simulation of prospective reduced-electrode acquisition. R-peaks are also localized from the synchronized reference channel defined above, so a label such as “V1” indicates that V1 is retained for cosine scoring, not that the complete preprocessing pipeline uses only that sensor. Since ECG channels and physical electrodes are not equivalent, all results are expressed in terms of channel counts.
blocks.zh: 频道仅在十二通道摘要创建后才会被移除,这意味着代表节拍使用全多头的弗罗贝尼乌斯距离来选择. 因此,该实验是一种积分通道减值,而不是模拟预期的减电罗德获取。 R峰也是从上面定义的同步参考通道本地化的,因此像"V1"这样的标签表明V1被保留用于余弦积分,而不是说完整的预处理管道只使用该传感器. 由于ECG通道和物理电极不相等,所有结果都用通道计数来表示.

blocks.en: Cross-dataset concordance is measured by ranking identical lead combinations according to EER and Rank-1 for every subset size k k , followed by Spearman correlation between the two datasets. Because the exhaustive subsets overlap and are not independent observations, these correlations are used descriptively to assess portability across cohorts.
blocks.zh: 根据EER和Rank-1对每个子集大小 k k k 进行相同的铅组合排序,然后是Spearman在两个数据集之间的相关性,以此衡量跨数据集的一致. 由于详尽无遗的子集是重叠的,不是独立的观察,这些关联被描述性地用来评估各组群的可移动性.

blocks.en: 3.10 Heatmap degradation stress test
blocks.zh: 3.10 加热图降解压力测试

blocks.en: ZACH-ViT and Compact-TransMIL are evaluated without retraining on clean and corrupted heatmaps. The experiment considers Gaussian noise with σ = 0.03 \sigma=0.03 and 0.06, Gaussian blur with radius 1 and 2, JPEG compression at quality 70 and 40, and resolution reduction to 112 × 112 112\times 112 and 64 × 64 64\times 64 followed by restoration to 224 × 224 224\times 224 .
blocks.zh: 对ZACH-ViT和Contract-TransMIL的评价没有再培训清洁和腐败热图。 实验考虑高斯噪音为: = 0.03\sigma=0.03和0.06, 高斯模糊半径1和2, JPEG压缩质量70和40, 分辨率还原为112×112 112\time112和64×64 64\time 64, 之后恢复为224×224\time224.

blocks.en: Pillow performs RGB blur and JPEG encoding and decoding, while bilinear interpolation is used for the resolution changes. NumPy adds noise in the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] pixel domain, clips the result, and initializes its generator with the corresponding training seed. We load the final 97-epoch weights, verify every model against the clean benchmark, and then run inference on CPU for all corruptions. The eight degraded conditions are averaged within each seed before the mean and standard deviation are reported over the five seeds.
blocks.zh: Pillow执行RGB模糊和JPEG编码和解码,而双线插值用于解析变化. NumPy在 [0, 1] [0,1] 像素域中添加噪音,剪辑结果,并用相应的训练种子初始化其生成器. 我们加载最后97世纪的重量,对照干净的基准验证每个模型,然后对所有腐败进行CPU推论. 在报告5个种子的平均值和标准差之前,每个种子平均有8个退化条件。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Dense heatmaps improve matched trace results
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 密集热图改进匹配的跟踪结果

blocks.en: Table 4 and Figure 2 compare traces and heatmaps generated from the same ECG summaries, with the model family, training budget, subject partition, and biometric protocol held fixed. Heatmaps reduce FNMR at FMR ≤ 10 % \leq 10\% and FNMR at FMR ≤ 1 % \leq 1\% in all 15 model-dataset comparisons, while also increasing Rank-1 and Rank-5 in every case. Mean EER improves in 14 of 15 comparisons. When averaged over the complete experiment, EER decreases by 9.59 percentage points and Rank-1 increases by 24.69 points; the corresponding average changes are 23.25 points for FNMR at FMR ≤ 10 % \leq 10\% , 24.66 points for FNMR at FMR ≤ 1 % \leq 1\% , and 17.97 points for Rank-5.
blocks.zh: 表4和图2比较了从同样的ECG摘要中产生的痕迹和热图,并确定了模式家庭、培训预算、主题划分和生物鉴别协议。 在FMR 10%\leq 10\%和FNMR 1%\leq 1\%所有15个模型-数据集比较中,热度降低FNMR,同时,在每一个案例中,排名1和排名5都有所增加。 在15个比较中,有14个改善平均经济ER。 在整个试验中,EER平均下降9.59个百分点,排名1增加24.69个百分点;相应的FMR平均变化为:FMR 10%\leq 10==23.25个百分点,FMR 1%\leq 1=24.66个百分点,排名5为17.97个百分点。

blocks.en: The representation effect is observed in all three datasets, with mean EER reductions of 5.10 points on PTB, 14.04 points on ECG-ID, and 9.62 points on MIMIC-DEMO. The respective Rank-1 increases are 15.94, 31.67, and 26.47 points. MIMIC-DEMO ABMIL provides the only exception in EER, changing from 33.88 ± 6.19 33.88\pm 6.19 % for the trace to 37.24 ± 3.14 37.24\pm 3.14 % for the heatmap, although both FNMR measures and both identification ranks still improve.
blocks.zh: 在所有三个数据集中都观察到了代表效应,平均EER在PTB上降5.10分,在ECG-ID上降14.04分,在MIMIC-DEMO上降9.62分. 排名1相应增加15.94分,31.67分,26.47分. MIMIC-DEMO ABMIL是EER中唯一的例外,微量值从33.88±6.19 33.88\pm 6.19%变为37.24±3.14 37.24\pm 3.14%的热图,尽管FNMR措施和两个识别级别都仍然有所改善。

blocks.en: ECG-ID provides the clearest single-lead control because its heatmap contains no inter-lead structure. ZACH-ViT improves from 22.75 ± 3.66 22.75\pm 3.66 % to 8.07 ± 0.96 8.07\pm 0.96 % EER, while Rank-1 increases from 36.11 ± 6.05 36.11\pm 6.05 % to 80.83 ± 1.16 80.83\pm 1.16 %. Compact-TransMIL shows the same pattern, reducing EER from 23.68 ± 4.10 23.68\pm 4.10 % to 6.86 ± 2.06 6.86\pm 2.06 % and increasing Rank-1 from 40.28 ± 11.74 40.28\pm 11.74 % to 80.00 ± 2.52 80.00\pm 2.52 %. These results indicate that dense rasterization improves access to the same normalized waveform even when no information is available across leads.
blocks.zh: ECG-ID提供了最明确的单头控制,因为它的加热图中没有铅间结构. ZACH-ViT从22.75±3.66 22.75\pm 3.66%提高到8.07±0.96 8.07\pm 0.96% EER,而Rank-1则从36.11±6.05 36.11\pm 6.05%提高到80.83±1.16 80.83\pm 1.16%. 契约-过渡 显示相同的模式,将EER从23.68±4.10 23.68\pm 4.10降低到6.86±2.06 6.86\pm 2.06%,将Rank-1从40.28±11.74 40.28\pm 11.74%提高到80.00±2.52 800.00\pm 2.52%。 这些结果表明,即使各线索之间没有信息,密集光栅化也能改善同一正常化波形的获取。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Paired representation effect for the five compact architectures across the three datasets. Each line connects the five-seed mean trace and heatmap result for the same architecture and fixed training protocol. Lower EER and higher Rank-1 are better. Heatmaps improve all 15 mean identification cells and 14 of 15 mean EER cells.

blocks.en: The strongest compact architecture varies across datasets and metrics. CCT-2/3 × \times 2 gives the lowest mean heatmap EER on PTB and MIMIC-DEMO, Compact-TransMIL gives the lowest mean EER on ECG-ID, and ZACH-ViT provides the highest compact-model Rank-1 on ECG-ID and MIMIC-DEMO. The consistent advantage of the heatmap is therefore not tied to a single architecture.
blocks.zh: 最强的紧凑结构因数据集和衡量标准而异。 CCT-2/3 ×\times 2给出了PTB和MIMIC-DEMO最低平均热量EER,Contract-TransMIL给出了ECG-ID最低平均热量EER,ZACH-ViT给出了ECG-ID和MIMIC-DEMO的最高紧凑型号Rank-1. 因此,热映射的一贯优势并不与单一建筑挂钩.

blocks.en: 4.2 Pretrained heatmap scale benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.2 预限热映射尺度基准

blocks.en: The ImageNet-pretrained screen contains 90 successful runs. As shown in Table 5 and Figure 3 , the strongest architecture depends on the dataset: ConvNeXt-Tiny gives the lowest mean EER on PTB and ECG-ID at 2.43 ± 0.50 2.43\pm 0.50 % and 5.79 ± 0.89 5.79\pm 0.89 %, respectively, whereas DeiT-Base leads MIMIC-DEMO with 14.92 ± 3.08 14.92\pm 3.08 %. Their corresponding Rank-1 values are 93.72 ± 1.44 93.72\pm 1.44 %, 84.72 ± 2.20 84.72\pm 2.20 %, and 81.68 ± 2.77 81.68\pm 2.77 %.
blocks.zh: ImageNet预装屏幕包含90个成功运行. 如表5和图3所示,最强的架构取决于数据集:ConvNEXt-Tiny对PTB和ECG-ID给出的平均值EER最低,分别为2.43±0.50 2.43\pm 0.50%和5.79±0.89 5.79\pm 0.89%,而DeiT-Base领先. MIMIC-DEMO为14.92±3.08 14.92\pm 3.08%,对应的Rank-1值为93.72±1.44 93.72\pm 1.44%,84.72±2.20 84.72\pm 2.20%,81.68±2.77 81.68\pm 2.77%.

blocks.en: Performance is not monotonically related to model size. ConvNeXt-Tiny outperforms the larger DeiT-Base on PTB and also provides the lowest mean EER on ECG-ID, while DeiT-Base becomes the strongest model on MIMIC-DEMO. Within the smaller transformers, DeiT-Tiny slightly outperforms DeiT-Small on both displayed metrics, and EfficientNet-B0 is competitive on PTB and ECG-ID but substantially weaker on MIMIC-DEMO. The complete five-metric results are reported in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 性能与模型大小并不单调相关. ConvNEXt-Tiny在PTB上超越了更大的Deit-Base,在ECG-ID上也提供了最低的平均值EER,而Deit-Base则成为MIMIC-DEMO上最强的模型. 在较小的变压器中,DeiT-Tiny在显示的两种度量衡上都略胜于DeiT-Small,高效网-B0在PTB和ECG-ID上具有竞争力,但在MIMIC-DEMO上则明显较弱。 附录B报告了完整的五度测定结果。

blocks.en: Despite its compact design, ZACH-ViT remains competitive across the three datasets. Its 0.25M-parameter configuration is more than two orders of magnitude smaller than DeiT-Base, yet on ECG-ID it performs close to several pretrained backbones. This result places ZACH-ViT on a favourable accuracy and model-footprint trade-off.
blocks.zh: 尽管ZACH-ViT的设计很紧凑,但它在三个数据集中仍然具有竞争力。 其0.25M参数配置比DeiT-Base小两个数量级以上,然而在ECG-ID上,它执行的骨干接近几个预训骨干. 这一结果使得ZACH-ViT处于有利的准确性和模型脚印的权衡.

blocks.en: 4.3 ImageNet initialization helps the multilead cohorts but is mixed for one lead
blocks.zh: 4.3 ImageNet初始化有助于多头组群,但为一头铅混合

blocks.en: The ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base ablations isolate initialization under a common 23-epoch protocol, with the paired results reported in Table 6 and Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: ConvNEXt-Tiny和DeiT-Base的模拟在共同的23世纪协议下隔离初始化,配对结果见表6和图4。

blocks.en: On PTB, pretraining reduces ConvNeXt-Tiny EER from 5.17 ± 0.57 5.17\pm 0.57 % to 2.43 ± 0.50 2.43\pm 0.50 % and increases Rank-1 from 78.92 ± 2.53 78.92\pm 2.53 % to 93.72 ± 1.44 93.72\pm 1.44 %. DeiT-Base follows the same trend, with EER decreasing from 5.85 ± 0.94 5.85\pm 0.94 % to 3.13 ± 0.85 3.13\pm 0.85 % and Rank-1 increasing from 77.21 ± 1.12 77.21\pm 1.12 % to 90.56 ± 2.01 90.56\pm 2.01 %. Both architectures improve in EER for every paired seed.

The effect is also pronounced on MIMIC-DEMO. ConvNeXt-Tiny reduces EER from 26.66 ± 3.27 26.66\pm 3.27 % to 19.41 ± 1.33 19.41\pm 1.33 % and increases Rank-1 from 47.85 ± 6.14 47.85\pm 6.14 % to 78.69 ± 5.14 78.69\pm 5.14 %, while DeiT-Base reduces EER from 26.22 ± 5.51 26.22\pm 5.51 % to 14.92 ± 3.08 14.92\pm 3.08 % and increases Rank-1 from 65.42 ± 1.14 65.42\pm 1.14 % to 81.68 ± 2.77 81.68\pm 2.77 %. As on PTB, EER improves for every paired seed in both models.

Single-lead ECG-ID follows a different pattern. Pretraining changes ConvNeXt-Tiny EER from 6.64 ± 1.01 6.64\pm 1.01 % to 5.79 ± 0.89 5.79\pm 0.89 %, but Rank-1 decreases from 88.06 ± 1.24 88.06\pm 1.24 % to 84.72 ± 2.20 84.72\pm 2.20 %. For DeiT-Base, EER changes from 6.00 ± 0.91 6.00\pm 0.91 % to 6.35 ± 0.97 6.35\pm 0.97 %, while Rank-1 changes from 79.72 ± 0.76 79.72\pm 0.76 % to 80.56 ± 4.81 80.56\pm 4.81 %. Visual pretraining is therefore consistently effective on the two multilead datasets, whereas its contribution on ECG-ID is limited and metric-dependent.

blocks.en: The compact models remain competitive with much larger scratch-trained architectures. On MIMIC-DEMO, CCT and Compact-TransMIL obtain 24.49% and 24.54% EER, compared with 26.66% and 26.22% for scratch ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base. ZACH-ViT reaches 65.23% Rank-1 in the same dataset, close to the 65.42% of scratch DeiT-Base, and on ECG-ID it reaches 80.83%, compared with 79.72% for scratch DeiT-Base. Since the training schedules differ, these comparisons concern achieved accuracy and model footprint rather than controlled model scaling.
blocks.zh: 紧凑的模型仍然具有竞争力,具有更大的刮痕训练架构。 在MIMIC-DEMO中,CCT和Compact-TransMIL获得24.49%和24.54%的ER,而ConvNext-Tiny和DeiT-Base获得26.66%和26.22%的ER。 ZACH-ViT在同一数据集中达到65.23%的Rank-1,接近抓取DeiT-Base的65.42%,在ECG-ID上达到80.83%,而抓取DeiT-Base为79.72%. 由于培训时间表不同,这些比较涉及实现准确性和模型足迹,而不是控制模型规模。

blocks.en: 4.4 Heatmaps are competitive with direct signal-domain methods
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 热图具有直接信号域方法的竞争力

blocks.en: Table 7 compares the four signal-domain references with the pretrained heatmap model that obtains the lowest mean EER in each dataset, using a common selection rule across the six-model screen.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Representative morphology as an image
blocks.zh: 5.1 代表性形态学作为图像

blocks.en: The proposed representation is not simply a different visualization of an ECG waveform. It begins with an ECGXtractor-style procedure that selects five central beats from every block of ten and averages them into a representative matrix that preserves cardiac time, amplitude, and acquired leads. This ECG-informed summary provides the common physiological basis for both image representations.
blocks.zh: 拟议的表述不仅仅是对ECG波形的一种不同的可视化. 它从ECGXtractor式程序开始,从每块10个中选择5个中心跳动,并平均形成一个保存心脏时间,振幅,并获得线索的代表性矩阵. 这份ECG知情总结为两种图像表现提供了共同的生理基础.

blocks.en: Since the trace and heatmap use the same matrix, heartbeat selection, alignment, normalization, and numerical samples remain fixed while only the image encoding changes. Heatmaps improve both FNMR measures and both identification ranks in all 15 compact model-dataset comparisons, and mean EER improves in 14 of them. The consistency of these gains across architectures and cohorts supports a representation-level effect rather than an advantage restricted to a particular model.
blocks.zh: 由于微量和热映射使用相同的矩阵,所以心跳选择,对齐,正常化,和数值样本保持固定,而只有图像编码改变. 在全部15个紧凑的模型-数据集比较中,热图改进了FNMR计量和两个识别排名,意味着其中14个改进了ER。 各架构和组别之间这些收益的一致性支持一种代表性效应,而不是仅限于某一特定模式的优势。

blocks.en: ECG-ID provides an important control because its heatmap contains a single physiological lead and therefore has no inter-lead structure. Even in this setting, ZACH-ViT reduces EER from 22.75% to 8.07% and increases Rank-1 from 36.11% to 80.83%, with Compact-TransMIL showing a similarly large EER improvement. Dense amplitude encoding can therefore benefit recognition independently of the multilead image structure, giving convolution and attention direct access to the complete morphology rather than to a sparse line drawing.
blocks.zh: ECG-ID提供了一个重要的控制,因为它的热映射含有单一的生理铅,因此没有铅间结构. 即使在这种环境下,ZACH-ViT将EER从22.75%降低到8.07%,并将Rank-1从36.11%提升到80.83%,Contract-TransMIL显示EER的改善程度也类似大。 因此,激振编码可以独立于多铅映像结构而促进识别,使演化和注意力直接进入完整的形态,而不是稀疏的线条绘图.

blocks.en: This matched construction defines the central scientific contribution. Although earlier studies have used ECG images, colour maps, CNNs, and vision transformers, our method converts an ECGXtractor-style representative morphology into one dense time-by-lead image and compares it with a conventional trace derived from the identical numerical source. The experiment therefore measures how the image representation itself affects ECG biometric recognition.
blocks.zh: 与此相匹配的构造确定了中心科学贡献. 尽管早期的研究使用了ECG图像,彩色地图,CNN,和视觉变形器,但我们的方法将ECGXtractor风格的代表性形态转换成一个密集的逐时图像,并将其与来自相同数字源的常规微量比较. 因此,实验衡量图像表现本身如何影响ECG生物鉴别。

blocks.en: 5.2 Visual pretraining and model size
blocks.zh: 5.2 视觉预训和模型尺寸

blocks.en: The pretrained benchmark extends the representation analysis to larger image encoders. On PTB and ECG-ID, the lowest EER is obtained by ConvNeXt-Tiny, whereas DeiT-Base is strongest on MIMIC-DEMO, and performance does not improve monotonically with the number of parameters. Architecture and initialization are consequently more informative than model size alone.
blocks.zh: 预训基准将表示分析扩展到更大的图像编码器. 在PTB和ECG-ID上,最小的EER由ConvNext-Tiny获得,而DeiT-Base在MIMIC-DEMO上最强,性能不会单调地随参数数而提高. 因此,建筑和初始化比模型规模更具有信息性。

blocks.en: The matched ablations reveal a clear transfer effect on the multilead datasets, where ImageNet initialization substantially improves both ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base. Its influence on ECG-ID is smaller and varies across metrics. One plausible interpretation is that generic visual features are particularly useful when the heatmap contains richer joint structure across cardiac time and multiple leads, although the present experiments do not establish this mechanism causally.
blocks.zh: 匹配的模拟显示,对多铅数据集有明显的传输效应,其中ImageNet初始化大大改进了ConvNEXt-Tiny和DeiT-Base两种数据。 它对ECG-ID的影响较小,并因指标而异。 一个可信的解释是,当热图包含更丰富的跨心脏时间和多条线索的联动结构时,通用视觉特征特别有用,尽管目前的实验没有因果地确定这种机制。

blocks.en: The compact models remain competitive even when compared with much larger architectures trained from scratch. CCT and Compact-TransMIL outperform both large scratch models in MIMIC-DEMO EER, while ZACH-ViT nearly matches scratch DeiT-Base in Rank-1 and exceeds it on ECG-ID. Achieving these results with approximately 0.25M parameters gives ZACH-ViT a favourable balance between accuracy and model footprint. The compact and large branches use different training schedules, however, so this comparison characterizes the achieved accuracy-size trade-off rather than controlled scaling.
blocks.zh: 即使与从零开始训练的大得多的建筑相比,紧凑的模型仍然具有竞争力。 在MIMIC-DEMO EER中,CCT和Contract-TransMIL两种大抓痕模型都比得上,而ZACH-ViT在Rank-1中几乎匹配抓痕DeiT-Base,并在ECG-ID上超过了它. 以大约0.25M参数实现这些结果,使得ZACH-ViT在精确度和模型足迹之间取得了有利的平衡. 然而,紧凑和大型分支使用不同的培训时间表,因此,这一比较的特征是所实现的准确度大小的权衡,而不是控制规模。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with signal-domain methods
blocks.zh: 5.3 与信号域方法的比较

blocks.en: The strongest heatmap models are competitive with the direct signal baselines. ConvNeXt-Tiny approaches the best signal EER on PTB and ECG-ID while providing the highest PTB Rank-1, and DeiT-Base gives the highest PTB Rank-5 in the complete pretrained screen. On MIMIC-DEMO, DeiT-Base is best on four metrics and tied for best on Rank-5. Direct signal methods nevertheless remain strongest for strict-FMR verification and Rank-1 on ECG-ID.
blocks.zh: 最强热映射模型与直接信号基线具有竞争力. ConvNEXt-Tiny在PTB和ECG-ID上接近最佳信号EER,同时提供最高的PTB Rank-1,Deit-Base在完整的预训屏幕中给予最高的PTB Rank-5. 在MIMIC-DEMO上,Deit-Base在4个度量衡上最好,在Rank-5上最好地捆绑. 然而,直接信号方法对于严格FMR核查和ECG-ID上的Rank-1来说仍然是最强的。

blocks.en: These findings show that rasterization does not impose an inherent performance ceiling when the image is constructed from a stable and discriminative ECG morphology. The heatmap can preserve information required for verification and identification while providing access to mature computer vision architectures and pretrained weights. Direct signal models remain an important alternative when waveform-specific processing is preferred, and the two representations should therefore be viewed as complementary system designs rather than mutually exclusive solutions.
blocks.zh: 这些研究结果表明,光栅化不会在图像从稳定和歧视性ECG形态构造时施加内在性能上限. 热映射可以保存核查和识别所需的信息,同时提供进入成熟的计算机视觉架构和预先训练的权重. 当偏爱波形特定处理时,直接信号模型仍然是一个重要的替代品,因此,两种表示方式应被视为互补的系统设计而不是相互排斥的解决方案.

blocks.en: 5.4 Lead-channel contribution
blocks.zh: 5.4 铅渠道的贡献

blocks.en: The exhaustive analysis shows that channel utility depends on both the dataset and the biometric task. PTB benefits from several scoring channels, although three channels nearly match the 12-channel EER and four channels nearly match its Rank-1. MIMIC-DEMO follows a different pattern, as selected single channels can match or improve the complete summary-cosine result.
blocks.zh: 详尽的分析表明,信道的效用取决于数据集和生物鉴别任务。 PTB从几个评分频道中获益,尽管三个频道几乎与12频道EER相匹配,四个频道几乎与它的Rank-1相匹配. MIMIC-DEMO遵循不同的模式,因为选定的单声道可以匹配或改进完整的汇总-共声结果.

blocks.en: Verification and identification also favour different combinations because they use the resulting score distributions in different ways. The cross-dataset correlations further show that the strongest subsets are not fully portable. Channel selection should therefore be guided by the intended acquisition setting and operating objective rather than by a universal ranking of ECG leads.
blocks.zh: 核实和鉴定也倾向于不同的组合,因为它们以不同的方式使用由此产生的分数分配. 跨数据集的关联性进一步表明,最强的子集并不是完全可移植的. 因此,频道选择应以预定的购置设置和业务目标为指导,而不是以ECG领先的通用排名为指导。

blocks.en: 5.5 Image degradation and deployment
blocks.zh: 5.5 导弹 图像退化和部署

blocks.en: Compact-TransMIL and ZACH-ViT remain stable under the tested image degradations, with small average EER changes under Gaussian noise, blur, JPEG compression, and resolution reduction. Rank-1 is slightly more sensitive but remains close to the corresponding clean result. A related iris PAD study using Patch-ABMIL, Compact-TransMIL, and ZACH-ViT also found architecture-dependent differences under Gaussian noise, blur, and JPEG compression [ 2 ] . Its unknown-PAI results further showed that relative robustness does not by itself establish deployment readiness.
blocks.zh: Contract-TransMIL和ZACH-ViT在经过测试的图像降解下保持稳定,在高斯噪音下有小的平均ER变化,模糊,JPEG压缩,分辨率降低. 排名1比较敏感,但仍接近相应的干净结果。 一项使用Patch-ABMIL,Contract-TransMIL,以及ZACH-ViT的相关iris PAD研究也发现,在高斯噪音,模糊,JPEG压缩[2]下,建筑依赖的区别. 其未知的PAI结果进一步表明,相对稳健本身并不能确立部署准备状态。

blocks.en: The complete experiments reveal two useful deployment routes. Compact models support CPU training and a small memory footprint, whereas larger pretrained architectures provide stronger absolute performance on several datasets. Representative-morphology heatmaps accommodate both regimes within the same image-domain framework, allowing the model choice to follow the available computational resources and required operating point.
blocks.zh: 完整的实验揭示了两条有用的部署路线. 契约模型支持CPU培训和一个小的内存足迹,而更大的预训架构在多个数据集上提供了更强的绝对性能. 代表性形态热图在同一图像域框架内兼顾了两种系统,使模型选择能够遵循可用的计算资源和所需的操作点.

blocks.en: 5.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.6 限制

blocks.en: The study has two main limitations. Although the biometric protocol uses distinct summary segments and excludes identity and sample leakage, it does not require gallery and probe samples to originate from separate recording sessions; long-term cross-session and cross-device performance therefore remains to be established. In addition, the lead analysis removes channels after multilead preprocessing, which makes it a measure of scoring-channel contribution rather than a prospective validation of reduced-sensor acquisition.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有两个主要局限。 虽然生物鉴别协议使用不同的摘要部分,排除身份和样本渗漏,但它并不要求从单独的记录会中生成画廊和探测器样本;因此,长期跨会场和交叉探测性能仍有待确定。 此外,牵头分析取消了多铅预处理后的渠道,这使得它成为评分渠道贡献的尺度,而不是预期对减传感器获取的验证.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced representative-morphology heatmaps for ECG biometric verification and identification. Starting from ECGXtractor-style beat selection, the method converts a 400 × L 400\times L summary matrix into a dense time-by-lead image and compares it with a conventional trace containing the same physiological samples. This matched design isolates the effect of image representation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了具有代表性的形态热图,用于ECG生物测定和鉴定。 从ECGXtractor风格的节拍选择开始,该方法转换一个400×L 400\times L汇总基质成一个密集的按时间排列的图像,并将其与含有相同生理样本的常规微量进行对比. 这种匹配的设计隔离了图像表现的效果.

blocks.en: Heatmaps improve both FNMR operating points and both identification ranks in all 15 compact model-dataset comparisons, while mean EER improves in 14. ZACH-ViT offers a particularly favourable balance between accuracy and model size, remaining competitive with architectures that contain substantially more parameters.
blocks.zh: 加热图改进了FNMR操作点和所有15个紧凑模型-数据集比较中的识别排名,而平均EER则改进了14个。 ZACH-ViT在精确度和模型大小之间提供了特别有利的平衡,仍然与包含更多参数的架构具有竞争力.

blocks.en: ImageNet initialization provides clear gains on PTB and MIMIC-DEMO, although its influence on ECG-ID is mixed. ConvNeXt-Tiny reaches 2.43% EER on PTB and 5.79% on ECG-ID, while DeiT-Base reaches 14.92% EER and 81.68% Rank-1 on MIMIC-DEMO. The best heatmap models approach the strongest signal EER on PTB and ECG-ID; on MIMIC-DEMO, DeiT-Base is best on four metrics and tied for best on Rank-5.
blocks.zh: ImageNet初始化为PTB和MIMIC-DEMO提供了明显的收益,尽管其对ECG-ID的影响有好有坏. ConvNEXt-Tiny在PTB上达到2.43%的EER,在ECG-ID上达到5.79%,而Deit-Base在MIMIC-DEMO上达到14.92%的EER和81.68%的Rank-1. 最佳热映射模型接近PTB和ECG-ID上最强的信号EER;在MIMIC-DEMO上,Deit-Base在4个度量衡上最好,在Rank-5上最好捆绑.

blocks.en: The lead-channel analysis provides a complementary result, showing that useful subsets depend on the dataset and biometric objective. Overall, representative-morphology heatmaps form a practical bridge between ECG signal processing and computer vision, supporting compact CPU models and larger pretrained architectures within the same representation.
blocks.zh: 牵头渠道分析提供了补充结果,表明有用的子集依赖于数据集和生物鉴别目标. 总体而言,代表性-形态热映射在ECG信号处理和计算机视觉之间形成了一个实用的桥梁,支持紧凑的CPU模型和同一代表范围内更大的预训架构.

blocks.en: Data and Reproducibility Statement

blocks.en: PTB, ECG-ID, and MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO are publicly available under their respective access terms, and no source ECG recordings are redistributed with this manuscript.
blocks.zh: PTB、ECG-ID和MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO根据各自的访问条件公开提供,没有源代码ECG录音与本手稿一起重新分配。

blocks.en: The reproducibility package contains the manuscript source, figure code, protocol summaries, and seed-level results, including all operating points, lead-channel tables, degradation results, and pretrained model results. It also documents the ConvNeXt-Tiny and DeiT-Base initialization experiments, while provenance records identify the source archives and their SHA-256 hashes.
blocks.zh: 复制包包含手稿源,图码,协议摘要,以及种子级结果,包括所有操作点,铅通道表,降解结果,以及预先训练的模型结果. 它还记录了ConvNEXt-Tiny和DeiT-Base初始化实验,而出处记录则识别出源档案及其SHA-256散列.

blocks.en: All stochastic experiments use seeds { 3 , 5 , 7 , 11 , 13 } \{3,5,7,11,13\} , and the biometric protocol uses seed 3 to keep the verification comparisons and gallery-probe assignments identical across models and training seeds. Code for preprocessing, rendering, training, and biometric evaluation will be released upon acceptance; dataset access remains governed by the original providers.
blocks.zh: 所有线粒体实验都使用种子 {3,5,7,11,13} → 3,5,7,11,13} 生物鉴别协议使用种子 3 来保持校验比较和画廊-探测任务在模型和培训种子上相同. 预处理、渲染、培训和生物鉴别评价的守则将在接受后公布;数据集访问仍由原始提供者管理。

blocks.en: Table 10: Complete compact-model operating points for the matched representation experiment. Values are percentages, mean ± \pm sample SD over five seeds. Trace and heatmap rows use the same ECG summaries, architecture, training budget, subject partition, and fixed biometric trials.
blocks.zh: 表10:匹配的表示实验的完整紧凑模型操作点。 数值是百分比,平均±\pm 样本SD超过5个种子. 跟踪和加热图行使用相同的ECG摘要、架构、培训预算、主题分区和固定生物鉴别试验。

blocks.zh: 附录B 完成预训热图基准

blocks.en: Table 11: Complete operating points for the six-model ImageNet-pretrained heatmap benchmark. Values are percentages, mean ± \pm sample SD over five seeds. Every run uses full fine-tuning for 23 epochs and the same fixed biometric protocol.
blocks.zh: 表11:六型影像网预装热映射基准的完整操作点. 数值是百分比,平均±\pm 样本SD超过5个种子. 每次运行都使用23个纪元和相同的固定生物鉴别协议的全微调.

blocks.zh: 附录C 完全匹配初始化

blocks.zh: 表12:对应的23世纪初始化的完整操作点。 所有值都是百分数, 平均值 ±\\pm 样本SD 超过五个训练种子。 在每个模型-数据集中,只有初始化变化.
